title: One-way station partner rule
text: T-3565: today a station on one leg of a one-way pair counts as one stop with a station on the other leg within 300 m (T-3348): the line serves the pair once each way, and clicking either can add the other. Your model ("a station on one-way track is just a one-way station") suggests dropping that pairing, so each one-way station is its own stop served by one direction. Drop it (my pick), or keep it?
